sections.title: What You'll Learn
sections.content:
Ready to learn **A Simple Java Program**?

Here's what we'll cover:

• Writing and understanding your first Java program
• Why this matters for your coding journey
• Hands-on examples you can try

sections.title: Core Concepts
sections.content:
Think of **A Simple Java Program** like building blocks. 

Every great program starts with small, simple pieces. This is one of those essential pieces!

• Start simple, then build up
• Practice makes it click
• Don't worry if it takes time - totally normal!

sections.title: Code Examples
Key Points
points: Every Java program must have at least one class and a main method as the entry point
The main method signature is: public static void main(String[] args)
System.out.println() prints output to the console followed by a new line
The class name must match the filename exactly (case-sensitive)
Java statements end with a semicolon and blocks are enclosed in curly braces

sections.title: Summary
sections.content: A Simple Java Program - Writing and understanding your first Java program. Master basics before advancing. Practice with the examples. Builds foundation for what's next.
